programs.title: Karm
programs.desc: Asha and Arvind are in love but are not allowed to marry by her astrologer father. They start living together and plan to start a family without getting married, but fate intervenes.

programs.title: Divorce
programs.desc: Mr. Oswal a rich, influential, and domineering man lives with his wife and two sons, namely Jayant and Ajay. He convinces his elder son, Jayant, that he cannot marry the girl he loves.

programs.title: Kal Ki Awaz
programs.desc: When a bank chairman's son is abducted and held for ransom, DSP Ali intervenes but cannot save the child. Later, his world is turned upside down when his daughter is kidnapped.

programs.title: Mr. X
programs.desc: Corrupt officials leave Officer Raghuram to die after he completes a secret operation. He consumes a healing solution with a side effect that makes him invisible and helps him take his revenge.

programs.title: Dharam Sankat
programs.desc: After his mother is killed by Jagira, Gopal is raised by Durga. Years later, Gopal's love for Durga and Birju turns into hatred when he learns they hail from a family of robbers.

programs.title: Numbri Aadmi
programs.desc: Shankar, a noble thief, attempts to kill Rana, his father's murderer, in a bid to seek revenge. However, Rana has powerful friends who stand in Shankar's way.
